title: Antiviral and anti-inflammatory activity of novel belladonna formulation against Japanese encephalitis virus via inhibition of p65 nuclear translocation and TNF-alpha mediated NF-kB signaling.
authors: Saxena, Shailendra K; Kumar, Swatantra; Maurya, Vimal K; Nayak, Debadatta; Kaushik, Subhash; Manchanda, Raj K; Gadugu, Srinivasulu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究颠茄制剂抗日本脑炎病毒及抗炎活性，涉及NF-kB信号通路和TRAF2-TRADD复合物分子对接，但核心是病毒与宿主炎症信号，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Japanese encephalitis (JE) is a mosquito-borne flavivirus infection, a major cause of viral encephalitis in South-East Asia with a CFR of ~30% and no specific treatment. Therefore, a novel belladonna formulation (BCT) was prepared and its antiviral and anti-inflammatory activity was elucidated during Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV) infection. Anti-JEV role of BCT was investigated aiming to prevent the infection in the peripheral immune cells. Antiviral activity of BCT was evaluated by plaque reduction assay, cell survival and apoptosis assay. BCT-mediated reduction in JEV-envelope expression was measured by indirect immunofluorescence, RT-PCR and Western blot assays. NF-kappaB expression and p65 nuclear translocation assays were determined to explore the mechanism of the action of BCT. TNF-alpha level was measured to evaluate the anti-inflammatory role of BCT during JEV infection. Consequently, molecular docking was performed with the TRAF2-TRADD complex. Our data suggested that BCT treatment reduces the JEV-plaque formation, JEV-induced cytopathic effects and increases cell survival. The antiviral effect of BCT was confirmed by reduction in the JEV-envelope protein expression. Moreover, BCT treatment and prevents the NF-kappaB activation via preventing the nuclear translocation of p65 and reduces the TNF-alpha levels. Our molecular docking analysis suggested that belladonna alkaloids interfere with the TRAF2-TRADD complex that results in inhibition of TNF-induced NF-kappaB signaling. For the first time, our data suggested that BCT reduces JEV expression and interferes with TNF-induced NF-kappaB signaling, thereby increasing cell survival via preventing the p65 nuclear translocation and may be used for the treatment and prevention of JE.Abbreviation: CFR: Case fatality rate; CAM: Complementary and alternative medicines; COX-2: Cyclooxygenase-2; IkappaB: Inhibitor kappa B; JE: Japanese encephalitis; JEV: Japanese encephalitis virus; NF-kappaB: Nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells; ORF: Open reading frame; TNFR: Tumor necrosis factor receptor; TNF-alpha: Tumor necrosis factor-alpha; TRADD: TNFR1-associated death domain protein; TRAF2: TNF Receptor Associated Factor 2.
abstract_zh: 日本脑炎（JE）是一种由蚊媒传播的黄病毒属感染，是东南亚病毒性脑炎的主要原因，其病死率（CFR）约为30%，且无特异性治疗方法。因此，制备了一种新型颠茄制剂（BCT），并阐明了其在日本脑炎病毒（JEV）感染过程中的抗病毒和抗炎活性。研究了BCT的抗JEV作用，旨在预防外周免疫细胞中的感染。通过空斑减少试验、细胞存活和凋亡试验评估了BCT的抗病毒活性。通过间接免疫荧光、RT-PCR和Western blot试验测定了BCT介导的JEV包膜表达减少。通过NF-kappaB表达和p65核转位试验确定了BCT的作用机制。通过TNF-alpha水平测定评估了BCT在JEV感染过程中的抗炎作用。最后，对TRAF2-TRADD复合物进行了分子对接分析。我们的数据表明，BCT处理减少了JEV空斑形成、JEV诱导的细胞病变效应，并增加了细胞存活率。BCT的抗病毒效果通过JEV包膜蛋白表达的减少得到证实。此外，BCT处理通过阻止p65的核转位来预防NF-kappaB的激活，并降低TNF-alpha水平。我们的分子对接分析表明，颠茄生物碱干扰TRAF2-TRADD复合物，从而抑制TNF诱导的NF-kappaB信号通路。我们的数据首次表明，BCT减少JEV表达并干扰TNF诱导的NF-kappaB信号通路，从而通过阻止p65核转位增加细胞存活率，并可能用于JE的治疗和预防。缩写：CFR：病死率；CAM：补充和替代医学；COX-2：环氧化酶-2；IkappaB：抑制因子kappa B；JE：日本脑炎；JEV：日本脑炎病毒；NF-kappaB：活化B细胞核因子kappa轻链增强子；ORF：开放阅读框；TNFR：肿瘤坏死因子受体；TNF-alpha：肿瘤坏死因子-α；TRADD：TNFR1相关死亡结构域蛋白；TRAF2：TNF受体相关因子2。
